data.name: Abiyyi
data.gender_notes: Abiyyi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Abiyyi is derived from the Arabic word ‘abi’, which means ‘father’. The suffix ‘yyi’ is a contracted form of ‘abu’, which is also an Arabic word meaning ‘father’. This name is often given to a child whose father is wise and righteous. The name signifies the respect and love that a child has for his father. The name Abiyyi carries the meaning “Father of a wise man” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abiyyi usually hope their child will grow to embody father of a wise man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A sign of respect and love towards one's father
data.etymology: Abiyyi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of a wise man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abiyyi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أبيي
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني الشخص الذي يتصف بالشجاعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'أ ب ي' والذي يعني الشخص الذي يتصف بالشجاعة والبسالة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع لوصف الأشخاص الذين يتصفون بالشجاعة والإيمان. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليدل على الشخص الذي يتميز بالشجاعة والقدرة على التضحية من أجل قضية عادلة.

in_urdu.name: ابی
in_urdu.meaning: ایک مذکر نام جس کا مطلب ہے بہادری کا حامل
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی मूल کا ایک مذکر نام، جس کا مطلب ہے بہادری کا حامل یا کسی کام کو کرنے کی ہمت رکھنے والا۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'أ ب ي' سے ماخوذ ہے، جو بہادری اور ہمت کی معانی رکھتا ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو بہادری اور خود قربانی کی صفات کا حامل ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر جب وہ کسی عظیم مقصد کے لئے لڑتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अबीयी
in_hindi.meaning: एक पुल्लिंग नाम जिसका अर्थ है वीरता का स्वामी
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा में हुई है। इसका अर्थ है वीरता का स्वामी या किसी कार्य को करने की हिम्मत रखने वाला। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'أ ب ي' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ होता है वीरता और साहस। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो वीरता और आत्म-बलिदान के गुणों का प्रतीक होते हैं, विशेष रूप से जब वे किसी महान उद्देश्य के लिए प्रयासरत होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: ابۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عربي اصل مذکر نوم، چې د زړورتیا او بيړه لرونکی سړی په معنی دی. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'أ ب ي' څخه اخیستل شوی، چې د زړورتیا او هڅې معنی لري. په افغان او پښتون قومونو کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د زړورتیا او ځان قرباني صفاتو خاوند وي، په ځانګړي ډول کله چې دوی د يو لوی مقصد لپاره مبارزه کوي.

in_english.long_meaning: Abiyyi is a male given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'أ ب ي' (abāy), which means 'to be brave' or 'courageous'. This name is mentioned in various Quranic contexts to describe individuals who embody bravery and unwavering faith. In Islamic tradition, Abiyyi signifies a person known for their valor, strength, and willingness to sacrifice for a noble cause. The name reflects positive attributes such as fearlessness, resilience, and determination, making it a significant choice for parents seeking to instill these virtues in their child.

The Arabic word ‘abi’ emphasizes the role of fathers in both bringing up their children and passing down cultural and religious values from one generation to another. The name Abiyyi, by acknowledging the vital role of fathers, celebrates the bond between parents and their children and reinforces the cultural belief in the importance of family ties.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic belief, every child is a gift from Allah, and giving the child an appropriate name that holds spiritual significance is a way of honoring Allah’s creation. The name Abiyyi carries a spiritual significance as it reflects the reverence and respect that the child holds for his father, and in turn, the father's responsibility as a guardian and caretaker to his child. It also reflects the Prophet Muhammad’s (PBUH) teaching on the importance of good character and righteousness, urging parents to be role models for their children. Ultimately, the name Abiyyi serves as a reminder of the sacred bond between parents and their children and the divine role of both in shaping the spiritual growth of the next generation.
